mission: A long-term collection of browser games made by Codex or other AI agents, used to observe AI game-making progress over time.
maintainerRole: The maintainer curates prompts, tests builds, publishes games, and documents provenance without hand-editing game code.

slotVariantRunPolicy.summary: The 99 game slots represent 99 game concepts, not 99 AI generations.
slotVariantRunPolicy.gameSlot: One official game concept in the 99-game archive.
slotVariantRunPolicy.modelVariant: A version of the same game concept made by a specific model or agent. Variants do not consume additional game numbers.
slotVariantRunPolicy.runRecord: One generation, revision, validation, or comparison attempt for a game or variant. Run records can grow indefinitely.

games.title: Signal Cartographer

provenance.notes: Model label is maintainer-declared for this project entry. Code, launcher updates, and documentation were generated by Codex under the no-human-code-edits project rule.
